SECRET

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
File No.
S.1, Special Branch
REPORT
Date May 28, 1937.

Subject Arrival and Departure of Japanese Naval Transport "Shiretoko".

Made by C.D.I. Sih Tse-liang Forwarded by

The Japanese Naval transport "Shiretoko" berthed
at the O.S.K. Wharf, 184 Yangtszepoo Road, at 3 p.m. May 19.
300 sailors landed and proceeded by Landing Party motor trucks
to the barracks on Kiangwan Road.
The following munitions were also unloaded on
May 19 from the same vessel :-
300 boxes of rifle ammunition.
100 boxes each containing six 8.75 cm. shells.
160 drums of kerosene oil.
30 bicycles.
100 gas drums.
On board the transport, the following was reported
to be loaded before its departure at 2.45 p.m. May 20.
A number of U.B. Beer boxes believed to contain
copper plates.
100 bales of old uniforms.
60 boxes of empty cartridges.
5 unserviceable motor trucks
Two hundred sailors left Shanghai in the transport
for Japan.

Sih Tse-liang
C. D. I.

D. C. (Special Branch)

（印：28 MAY 1937 SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE）

日期：1937年5月28日。

主题：日本海军运输船“知床”号（Shiretoko）的抵达与离境。

制作人：C.D.I. 施子良 转呈人

日本海军运输船“知床”号于5月19日下午3时停靠在杨树浦路184号大阪商船会社（O.S.K.）码头。
300名水兵登陆，并乘坐登陆队卡车前往江湾路兵营。
同日（5月19日），该船还卸下了以下军火：
300箱步枪弹药。
100箱，每箱装有6枚8.75厘米炮弹。
160桶煤油。
30辆自行车。
100个煤气罐。
据报，在该运输船于5月20日下午2时45分离港前，船上装载了以下物品：
若干箱友邦啤酒（U.B. Beer），据信内装铜板。
100包旧制服。
60箱空弹壳。
5辆无法使用的卡车。
200名水兵随该运输船离开上海前往日本。

施子良
刑事侦缉督察 (C. D. I.)

副总监（特科）

（印：1937年5月28日 上海公共租界工部局警务处）

File No. ...
Special Branch. SXXXX
REPORT
Date. November 30, 36.

Subject. War preparations in Wusih.

Made by. ............ and .................... Forwarded by. Supt. Tan Shaopliang.

Following the measures adopted at Soochow, the
Authorities of Wusih, according to arrivals in Shanghai,
have ordered the residents to paint their walls and roofs
black as a precaution against air raids.
There are over 10,000 troops scattered around Wusih
and the Commanders are commandeering male adults for
transportation work and trench digging. Every household
has to provide one or two persons together with meals. The
period of service is one week a month.
The Shanghai Passport Office has received instructions
from the Wai Chiao Pu not to visa foreign passports to
Kashing, Chapoo, Kiangin and Wenchow. for the time being.

Tan Shaopliang
Superintendent.

D. C. (Special Branch).

主题：无锡的战备情况。

制作人：............ 和 .................... 转呈人：谭绍良警司。

据抵沪人士称，继苏州采取相关措施后，无锡当局已命令居民将墙壁和屋顶涂黑，以防空袭。
无锡周围散布着一万多军队，指挥官们正在征用成年男性从事运输工作和挖掘战壕。每户必须提供一两人并自备伙食。服役期为每月一周。
上海护照办事处已收到外交部指示，暂时不在前往嘉兴、乍浦、江阴和温州的外国护照上签证。

Subject H.I.J.M. Navy Transport "Shiritoko" arrives at Shanghai.
Made by D.I. Sih Tse-liang Forwarded by [Signature]
The name of the Japanese naval transport which arrived
at the O.S.K. Wharf in the morning of November 20 is "Shiritoko"
( 知床 ) and not "Nojima" as reported on November 20. The
following stores were unloaded in addition to those previously
reported :-
41 Gun shells.
91 Aerial bombs.
220 Light gun shells.
16 Small hand carts.
4,000 Sand bags.
3,000 Winter uniforms.
100 Steel plates.
200 Wooden poles.
300 boxes small arms ammunition.
The following articles were loaded on board :-
2 10 c.m. guns.
100 machine guns, rifles, etc.
2 motor trucks.
4 motor cycles.
1,000 summer uniforms.
200 bags of sugar.
This vessel left Shanghai for Japan at 3.30 p.m. Nov. 21,
the only ratings on board being the Sih Tse-hiang
crew. D. I.
D. C. (Special Branch)
Div. - S.
S.B. 231.

Shenlako Date. Nov. 20, 1936.
Subject H.I.J.M. Navy Transport "Nojima" arrives at Shanghai.
Made by D.I. Sik Tse-liang Forwarded by [Signature]
Shenlako
The Japanese Naval Transport "Nojima" arrived at
the C.S.R. Wharf at 8 a.m. November 20 with 500 members of
the Japanese Naval Landing Party and a cargo of munitions,
etc. and food supplies.
The members of the Landing Party disembarked and
proceeded in motor trucks to the Japanese Naval Landing
Party barracks, Kiangwan Road.
The unloading of the cargo is in progress and
the following articles and commodities have been landed :-
30 motorcycles with sidecars equipped with stands
for machine guns.
2 motor trucks.
1,800 boxes of rifle, pistol and machine gun ammunition.
Steel plates each measuring 8' by 4' by 3/5".
Wooden poles, each 12' in length and 8" in diameter.
Food and medical supplies.

18.11.36.

General Information.

All persons occupying premises in Soochow have
been required by the Military Authorities to paint the
roof black, a precautionary measure in the event of an
air raid.

Since the opening of the Yoh-Han Railway north
bound trains from Canton to Hankow have been reserved
solely for the transportation of troops and military
supplies.

Oil companies supplying gasoline to the Central
Government were recently required to construct additional
storage in Shensi and Honan and supply an amount of
gasoline equivalent to that distributed to military
centers in one year.

The Japanese Embassy has issued a report to the
effect that Agnes Smedley is collecting contributions
from Chinese organizations on behalf of the National
Salvation Association.

In connection with the meeting recently convened
by Doo Yuet Sung and other leaders of the Chinese
community, it is rumoured that General Chiang will make
use of the Red Pang and the Green Pang in the present
national crisis.

-----

（印：SPECIAL BRANCH / 18 NOV. 1936 / ...）
（批：D1373/187"）
page_data.zh:
1936年11月18日。

一般情报。

苏州的所有住户均被军事当局要求将屋顶涂黑，这是防备空袭的预防措施。

自粤汉铁路开通以来，从广州开往汉口的北行列车已专门用于运送军队和军用物资。

向中央政府供应汽油的石油公司最近被要求在陕西和河南修建额外的储油设施，并提供相当于一年内分发给各军事中心数量的汽油。

日本大使馆发布了一份报告，称艾格尼丝·史沫特莱（Agnes Smedley）正在代表全国救国会向中国组织募集捐款。

关于杜月笙和其他华人领袖最近召开的会议，有谣言称蒋将军将在当前的国家危机中利用红帮和青帮。

-----

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
S.I, Special Branch XXXXX
REPORT
Date October 21, 19 36.

Subject Japanese Authorities demand the removal of mayor Wu Teh Chen
(Further to report dated October 16, 1936).

Made by D.I. Sih Tse-liang Forwarded by [Signature]

Discreet enquiries made at the same source from which
the information regarding the local Tangpu's protest against
the Japanese Authorities' demand for the transfer of mayor
Wu was obtained, show that no reply has yet been received from
the C.E.C. of the Kuomintang at Nanking to the telegram
despatched by the local Tangpu urging that the demand be
rejected. It is learned that, as a rule, such telegrams
would be filed by the higher authorities and that a reply is
seldom considered necessary.

The Tangpu consider that information on this matter
should not be divulged so as not to increase the anti-Japanese
feelings of local citizens and aggravate the local situation.

Sih Tse liang
D. I.

D. C. (Special Branch)
（印：SPECIAL BRANCH SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE 21 OCT. 1936）

制作人：侦缉督察 施子良 转呈人 [签名]

通过获取有关当地党部抗议日本当局要求调任市长吴铁城这一信息的同一来源进行的谨慎查询显示，南京国民党中央执行委员会尚未回复当地党部发出的要求拒绝该要求的电报。据悉，通常情况下，此类电报会被上级当局归档，且很少认为有必要回复。

党部认为，此事信息不应泄露，以免增加当地市民的反日情绪并加剧当地局势。

Subject.........Japanese authorities demand the removal of Mayor Wu

Made by Det. Sih Tse-liang.......Forwarded by [Signature]

It is reliably reported that the Japanese Authorities
have submitted a demand to the National Government for the
removal of General Wu Teh-chen from his post of Mayor of the
Shanghai Municipality on the ground that he protested against
the activities of the Japanese Naval Landing Party in Shanghai.
On learning of this, the local Tangbu on October 15 secretly
despatched a telegram to the C.I.C. of the Kuomintang urging
that the demand be rejected, and that the praiseworthy action
of Mayor Wu should be strongly supported.

October 23, 1936.

Japanese Naval Landing Party Acquire Additional Premises.

Premises No. 265 Darroch Road, a large Chinese
dwelling house, which is near the place where the
Japanese marine, Nakayama, was shot on 9th November
1935, has been taken over by the Japanese Naval Landing
Party to house additional staff officers. The monthly
rental of the premises is $450.00 and alterations are
in progress to meet the requirements of the Landing Party.
Sentries have been posted at the front gate which faces
Boon Loh Li (豐樂里).

Dixwell Road Station
October 22, 1936.

Japanese Naval Landing Party occupy new premises.

I respectfully beg to report that the premises
No. 265 Darroch Road, a large Chinese dwelling house,
built and owned by Lee Kwei Sung, stock and share broker,
adjoining the garage on the North side and on the West
side of Darroch Road(where the Japanese marine, Nakayama,
was shot on the night of 9th November 1935) has been taken
over by the Japanese Naval Landing Party as an extra
staff office for additional staff officers, these premises
have been rented at a sum of $450.00 per month and alterations
are in progress to fit the premises up to the requirements
of the J.N.L.P. Mr. Lee has removed to Avenue Road near
Seymour Road. Conversation with Mr. Lee at his office
address No.69 Kiukiang Road, Tel. 13163-4-5 states that he
handed over the lease to the J.N.L.P. on October 17, 1936,
two marine sentries are now posted on duty at the front
gate which faces Foong Loh Li.

FILE
106

1936年10月22日。

日本海军陆战队占用新房产。

谨此报告，达罗克路265号 premises（房产），这是一栋由股票经纪人李桂生（Lee Kwei Sung，音译）建造并拥有的大型中式住宅，毗邻达罗克路北侧和西侧的车库（1935年11月9日晚日本水兵中山在此被枪击），已被日本海军陆战队接管，作为额外参谋军官的补充参谋办公室，该房产以每月450.00美元的价格租出，目前正在进行改建以符合日本海军陆战队（J.N.L.P.）的要求。李先生已搬至近西摩路的爱文义路。在其办公地址九江路69号（电话：13163-4-5）与李先生的谈话表明，他已于1936年10月17日将租约移交给日本海军陆战队，目前两名海军哨兵在面向丰乐里的前门执勤。

page_data.en:
Translation of French Report dated October 20, 1936

Concentration of Chinese troops in Soochow-Nanking and
Hangchow-Kashing-Sungkiang areas.

Following the strained relationship between China and Japan,
the Commission of National Military Affairs (General Chiang Kai
Shek) has reinforced the troops stationed in the Soochow-Nanking
and Hangchow-Kashing-Sungkiang areas..

A/ Soochow-Nanking area

Before September 20 the following troops were stationed in
this region :

1) The 87th Division (General WANG KING KIU -王敬玖), the units
of which were distributed between Kiangying and Changshu.

2) Four regiments of the Kiangsu Peace Preservation Corps, quartered
in the Chingkiang area.

3) The Instructional Division, quartered at Nanking.

4) The 23rd Independent Artillery Regiment, stationed at Nanking.

5) The 8th(?) Liaison Regiment, stationed at Nanking and

6) The 1st Regiment of Engineers, stationed at Nanking.

Between September 22 and October 3, the following units
appeared to have been transferred into this region :

11th Division (General KAO LI TSU) (甘勵初)
36th Division (General SUNG CHI LIEN -宋希濂)
78th Division (General KWEI YUNG TSING -桂永清 )
88th Division (General SHEN YUAN LIANG -孫元良 )
3rd Independent Artillery Regiment (Colonel LI TE MING -李法明 )
4th Independent Artillery Regt. (Colonel KUNG KING KWEI -孔慶桂 )

Defence works are understood to have been thrown up at Kiating
and Yushan.

At Nanking, the surrounding hills - Tse Ching Shan (紫金山),

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
SECRET REPORT
File No. 7552
S.1, Special Branch
Date October 20, 1936.

Subject Present Political Situation.

Made by D. S. McKeown Forwarded by [签名]

The latest development in the situation was the conference held in Hangchow on October 18, attended by Chiang Kai-shek and a number of prominent military leaders. From reliable sources, it is learned that the leaders pledged support to the decisions of the Nanking Government. It was resolved that every effort should be made to settle the Sino-Japanese problem amicably, but that China should not cede further territory to Japan, and should refuse to allow Japan to assist in the communist suppression campaign.

Enquiries also elicit the information that the situation is tense in Nanking. The more conservative of the Chinese politicians are in favour of taking for granted the fact that the Japanese are established in Jehol and Manchuria and cannot be removed. The less conservative will not agree to this attitude, and maintain that China must exercise sovereign rights over all her present and former territory. All the politicians, however, are in accord on the point that further territory cannot be ceded to Japan. Hence the diplomats and the military leaders are prepared to show a united front.

The Japanese are well aware of this attitude. Major-General Kita, the military attache, is taking a pessimistic view. He foresees a breakdown in the forthcoming negotiations and a recurrence of anti-Japanese incidents which will lead to the Japanese taking free action. The massing of Chinese troops is also causing grave concern, and in this respect it is interesting to note that the Russian Abolnik of the Tass News Agency formerly residing in Shanghai and now in Peiping is sending frequent and detailed reports of troop movements to Moscow. These reports are for the most part accurate,

（左侧批注：C.P. / Dc(D) / D.C.(C)）
（左侧印章：SPECIAL BRANCH / SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE / 20 OCT. 1936）

档案号 7552
S.1，特别股
日期 1936年10月20日。

主题 当前政治局势。

撰写人 D. S. McKeown 转呈人 [签名]

局势的最新发展是10月18日在杭州举行的会议，蒋介石和多位著名军事领导人出席了会议。据可靠消息来源获悉，这些领导人承诺支持南京政府的决定。会议决议尽一切努力和平解决中日问题，但中国不应再向日本割让领土，并应拒绝允许日本协助剿共运动。

查询还获悉，南京局势紧张。较为保守的中国政客倾向于理所当然地接受日本已占据热河和满洲且无法被驱逐的事实。较不保守的政客不同意这种态度，坚持认为中国必须对其所有现有及 former 领土行使主权。然而，所有政客在一点上是一致的，即不能再向日本割让更多领土。因此，外交官和军事领导人准备展现统一阵线。

日本方面很清楚这种态度。武官北田少将（Major-General Kita）持悲观看法。他预见即将到来的谈判将会破裂，反日事件将再次发生，从而导致日本采取自由行动。中国军队的集结也引起了严重关切，在这方面，值得注意的是，塔斯社前驻上海、现驻北平的俄国记者阿博尔尼克（Abolnik）正频繁地向莫斯科发送关于军队调动情况的详细报告。这些报告大多准确，

（左侧批注：C.P. / Dc(D) / D.C.(C)）
（左侧印章：特别股 / 上海公共租界工部局警务处 / 1936年10月20日）

The situation in Shanghai is normal. Reports which
would tend to agitate the people are being excluded from the
Press by the local censors. The fear of immediate hostilities
which followed the shooting of the Japanese marine on
September 23 has now subsided. Again, Mayor Wu Te Chen, with
the approval of higher officials, has adopted a stern attitude
in connection with the activities of the national salvation
societies. Arrests have already been made as an example, and
the leaders have been warned to desist from all activities
under pain of immediate and direct action being taken against
them.
Developments in the situation depend entirely upon
the result of the forthcoming negotiations. The local
national salvation societies are influenced partly by Mayor
Wu's warnings, and partly because they are inspired with the
hope that China will flatly refuse to make further concessions
to Japan. Any compromise will be distasteful to the
societies, and should a compromise be effected, the local
societies will no doubt recommence their activities.

上海局势正常。当地审查机构正在从报刊中剔除那些可能煽动民众的报道。9月23日日本海军陆战队员被枪击后引发的对立即爆发敌对行动的恐惧现已平息。此外，吴铁城市长在上级官员的批准下，对救国会的活动采取了严厉态度。已逮捕一些人以儆效尤，并警告领导人停止一切活动，否则将直接对他们采取即时行动。
局势的发展完全取决于即将进行的谈判结果。本地救国会一方面受到吴市长警告的影响，另一方面也受到中国将断然拒绝向日本做出进一步让步的希望所鼓舞。任何妥协都会令这些团体感到厌恶，如果达成妥协，本地团体无疑将重新开始其活动。

French Police Translation dated October 20, 1936

Movements of Japanese Forces

The Japanese cruisers NAGARA, SENDAI and JINTSU, of the
8th Division of the 1st Squadron left Shanghai at 3.30 p.m.
on October 19. Now only one cruiser, four destroyers and one
gun-boat remain in port.

During the day the Japanese naval authorities reduced
the strength of the troops in Chapei. At Rokusan Garden there
remains only one post of four men, and the adjacent barracks
is occupied by only 40 men, in place of 300.

Some thirty cases landed from the transport KOSHIMA
were transported from the Osaka Shosen Kaisha Company godown
No.4 on board the cruiser SENDAI. There still remains a
thousand cases in the Company's godowns. The Settlement Police
believe that the godown shelters a large amount of material,
comprising among other things, 70 armoured cars, 60 lorries etc

As the godowns are being strictly guarded it will not be
possible to verify this information until the material in
question is removed to the Japanese barracks in North Szechuen
Road.

法国警察译文，日期为1936年10月20日

日军动向

第一舰队第8分队的日本巡洋舰“名取”号（NAGARA）、“仙台”号（SENDAI）和“神通”号（JINTSU）于10月19日下午3点30分离开上海。现在港内仅剩一艘巡洋舰、四艘驱逐舰和一艘炮艇。

白天，日本海军当局减少了闸北的兵力。在六三花园仅保留一个四人哨位，相邻的兵营仅驻扎40人，而非之前的300人。

从运输船“高岛”号（KOSHIMA）卸下的约三十箱货物，从大阪商船会社第4号仓库运上了“仙台”号巡洋舰。该公司仓库内仍剩有一千箱货物。租界警方认为该仓库藏有大量物资，其中包括70辆装甲车、60辆卡车等。

由于仓库受到严密守卫，在相关物资被移至北四川路的日本兵营之前，无法核实这一信息。

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
File No. ............
S.I., Special Branch Station,
REPORT
Date October 16, 19 36.

Subject Local Peace Preservation Corps and the Central Military
Police stationed in Shanghai.

Made by ........................................ Forwarded by [Signature]

Attached herewith is a List "A" of local Peace
Preservation Corps showing their present disposition, strength
and equipment. The units of this Corps have been recently
re-numbered in order to facilitate control.

These units were originally stationed in Nantao and
Chapei until on or about October 6 when they were all secretly
transferred to various strategic points in Chapei and the
suburbs of Shanghai, including Tahzang (大場), as a precaution-
ary measure against any emergency arising out of the tension
in Sino-Japanese relations. At that time, all members were
dressed in civilian clothes in order to conceal their identity
and instructed to avoid business centres as much as possible.
As the local situation has eased to some extent at present,
members of these units are now in uniform, but are still
confined to barracks, holding themselves in readiness for any
emergency. They are each provided with complete equipment,
including hand grenades and full stocks of ammunition.

The headquarters of the 1st Regiment of the Paouhulul,
which was moved to the Military Club, Sin Kee Road, Nantao,
when the secret transfer took place, has officially been moved
back to 250 Hung Joo Road, Chapei, while that of the 2nd
Regiment is still officially located in the Military Club,
Nantao, although the former unit has actually established an
office at Tahzang and the latter, at Chenju. Both these
offices will be used as field headquarters by the respective
units in the event of trouble.

List "B", appended to this report, shows the disposition
of the Central Military Police now stationed in Nantao.

（印：SPECIAL BRANCH / 16 OCT. 1936 / SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE）

REPORT
Date October 15, 1936.

Subject Present Political Situation.
SECRET

Made by D.S. McKeown Forwarded by [签名]

Further to Special Branch Report dated October 7
concerning the present tension in Sino-Japanese relations,
enquiries have elicited the following information :-

The impasse which arose when the Nanking Government
stipulated certain conditions before entering into negotiations
regarding the Japanese demands has not yet been removed. The
present parleys conducted between Mr. Suma, Japanese Consul
General at Nanking and Mr. Kao Tsung Yu, Director of the
Asiatic Affairs Bureau of the Ministry of Foreign Affairs are
regarded by Chinese politicians as of little importance. Mr.
Suma appears to be highly unpopular owing to the fact that
he insisted upon the acceptance of all the Japanese demands.
Mr. Kawagoe, the Japanese Ambassador to China, was reported
to be taking a less rigid view, and was willing to effect a
compromise if the Nanking Government would agree to accept half
of the demands submitted. With these two officials in disagree-
ment, Mr. Kuwajima, the Special Courier of the Japanese
Foreign Office, arrived in China and after discussions with
them suggested that they should endeavour to obtain the
acceptance of 70% of the demands, without however giving a
final decision. The Japanese Foreign Office has issued
further instructions to its ministers in China after Mr.
Kuwajima submitted his report on the situation.

Meanwhile Mr. Kawagoe is reported to be dissatisfied
with the present state of affairs, which report may have led
to the rumours that he is considering tendering his resignation.

No development in the situation is expected until the
instructions from Tokyo are carried out. The Nanking
Government is content to wait until the final demands are

C.P.
[签名]
15 OCT. 1936

密件

制作人 D.S. McKeown 转呈人 [签名]

继10月7日关于中日关系当前紧张局势的特别处报告之后，经查询获悉以下信息：

南京政府规定在接受日本要求之前须满足某些条件，由此产生的僵局尚未消除。目前，日本驻南京总领事须磨弥吉郎先生与外交部亚洲司司长高宗武先生之间进行的会谈，被中国政界人士认为无足轻重。须磨先生似乎极不受欢迎，因为他坚持要求接受日本的所有要求。据报道，日本驻华大使川越茂先生看法较为灵活，如果南京政府同意接受所提要求的一半，他愿意达成妥协。由于这两位官员意见不一，日本外务省特派员桑岛（Kuwajima，音译）先生抵达中国，在与他们讨论后建议他们努力争取获得对70%要求的接受，但未作出最终决定。在桑岛先生提交局势报告后，日本外务省已向其在华公使发出进一步指示。

与此同时，据报道川越茂先生对现状感到不满，这一消息可能导致了他考虑辞职的谣言。

在东京的指示得到执行之前，预计局势不会有进一步发展。南京政府满足于等待日本提出最终要求

C.P.
[签名]
1936年10月15日

Manoeuvres including trench digging and sandbag filling
are carried out daily by some 200 members of the Japanese Naval
Landing Party on a piece of vacant ground to the west of Ying
Hwa Li, off Robison Road, U.U.L. adjoining N.W.K. No.1 and 2,
Mills, in the morning and afternoon. Each practice lasts
about 1½ hours.
This piece of land, which is surrounded by a wall
about 10 feet high, formerly belonged to one named Pan Nyi Tai
(潘義泰), a land owner in the Western District, and has
been sold to the N.W.K. Mills. An entrance has been constructed
in the wall adjoining the N.W.K. No.1 and 2 Mills, thus
facilitating entrance and communication without resorting to
the use of the roadway.

Sir,
At 2.p.m. 12-10-36, the undersigned and C. P. S. 1243,
proceeded to the Customs jetty in order to resume jetty duty.
On the roadway extending the whole length of Pontoon No.
11. (opposite Kiukiang Road) a distance of about 100 yards,
there was a line of piled rifles and machine guns, with a pile
of stacked kitbags at the North end of the line.
About 100 Japanese sailors were present with several of
their number armed with rifles and facing outwards, guarding
the weapons.
Pedestrians were being prevented from walking along the
East pavement between the pontoon and the weapons.
There was a space between the sentries and the West foot-
path so that no obstruction was caused to vehicular traffic.
C. P. C. 1498, on duty at the jetty, (No.4. Beat.) informed
the undersigned that the party had arrived at about 1.p.m.
At about 2-30.p.m. several Naval trucks arrived and the
party left by truck in a Northerly direction.

9.30 a.m. October 13, 1936.

Subject : Situation in the Settlement.
Movement of Japanese Forces.
Movement of Chinese Forces.

Reference : CR 1532/S of October 12, 1936.
Murder of Japanese Marine Taminato.

Information confirmed from different sources indicate that plain
clothes soldiers are now located to the south of Shanghai in the
vicinity of Lunghua. It appears that they arrived by train during last
week from Nanking in small groups, changing their garments at the
Hsinlunghua railway station. About three hundred soldiers are billeted
in the Lunghua village.

The North Railway Station Police was yesterday reinforced by
60 policemen from different stations of the P.S.B. The P.S.B. having
been informed that certain Chinese were purchasing for the Japanese
important quantities of jute sacks and bags, arrested yesterday evening
two Chinese who had come with a truck to take delivery of 30,000 sacks
from the Wen Shen Store, 7 Wei Kuan Huang Ka, Nantao. The truck and
the sacks were seized and the owner of the store was placed under
arrest.

Yesterday we reported on the arrival of three Japanese cruisers
belonging to the 8th. Division of the 1st. Squadron. At 2.45 p.m. about
200 marines were disembarked from the Nagara, whilst at 3.15 p.m.
150 men landed from the Jintsu. The 350 men were taken to the barracks
on North Szechuan Road.

Signed : Sarly.

I motored along the new highway leading to
Soochow, Wusieh, etc. on Sunday last to make general observation.
On the way to Nanziang I came across a barrier
where officers wearing Sun Yat-sen uniform and speaking the
Shanghai dialect stopped my car and put me through an
interrogation before I was allowed to proceed. All buses
proceeding towards Shanghai were crowded with passengers
with their baggage piled high on the top of the vehicles.
The exodus is apparently due to the presence of newly arrived
troops scattered around the villages.
It is said that some of the troops are in plain
clothes and are prohibited from going near the highway or
the main streets where shops are located so as to avoid
attracting public attention.

Translation of French Report dated October 12, 1936

Situation in the International Settlement
Movements of Japanese and Chinese Forces

The situation remains much the same as it was on Saturday.

A new Chinese bureau has been rented in the French Concession. It is to be a statistics office and will be established at Nos. 6 & 12, Lane 1292 RueLafayette.

Only a few new removals have been reported from Chapel, which is now three parts evacuated.

It seems that the Chinese mean to organise their defences to the North of the town. During the past two days emplacements for automatic weapons have been set up along the whole length of the TAN TSE WEI creek ( ) bordering Chapel from the South-West to the North-East.

One thousand plain clothes soldiers are reported to have arrived at Quinsan on October 9 and to be lodging with the townspeople.

The Social Bureau is engaged in recruiting 100 mechanics for the requirements of the aviation centre at Nanchang.

At 11 p.m. on the 9th instant the following quantities of aircraft bombs were transported from the arsenal at Nantao to Nanking :

1600 of 18 kg.; 100 of 50 kg.; 30 of 250 kg.

On October 10 three vehicles belonging to the Chapei Fire Brigade were brought into the French Concession. They are garaged at No.12 Route Magy, the residence of Mr CHEN PING CHIEN, Chief of the Brigade. These vehicles belong to Mr Chen, who collects subscriptions from merchants towards the upkeep of the Fire Brigade.

During the morning of October 11 the Japanese naval strength was augmented by three cruisers : the NAGARA, SENDAI and JINTSU. These three vessels belong to the 8th Division of the 1st Squadron (Yokosuka). The Nagara gauges 5100 tons, with a speed of 33 knots. She is armed with 7 140 m/m guns, two anti-aircraft guns of 76 m/m, 2 machine guns and 8 torpedo tubes of 533 m/m. and carries a crew of 438 men. The two other vessels, which are a variation of the Nagara, possess the same armament. Each ship carries a sea-plane which takes off by the catapult system.

The following vessels were in port this morning :

cruisers IDZUMO (Vice-Admiral OIKAWA); SENDAI (rear-admiral JINTSU and NAGARA; torpedo-boats FUMIZUKI, NAGATSUKI and SAZUKI of the 22nd Squadron, and SHIOKAZE and SHIMAKAZE of the 3rd Squadron, representing a total of four cruisers five torpedo-boats.

国际租界局势
日军和华军动向

局势与周六时基本相同。

在法租界租用了一处新的中国机构办公地。这将是一个统计局，设立于拉斐特路1292弄6号和12号。

据报从闸北迁出的人家不多，该地区目前已疏散了四分之三。

看来中国人打算在城镇北部组织防御。在过去两天里，沿着从西南到东北环绕闸北的谭子围（TAN TSE WEI）河道全线，已设置了自动武器的阵地。

据报道，10月9日有一千名便衣士兵抵达昆山，并寄宿在市民家中。

社会局正在为南昌航空中心的需求招募100名技工。

本月9日晚11时，以下数量的飞机炸弹从南市兵工厂运往南京：

18公斤重的1,600枚；50公斤重的100枚；250公斤重的30枚。

10月10日，三辆属于闸北消防队的车辆被带入法租界。它们停放在麦琪路12号，即消防队队长陈炳谦先生的寓所。这些车辆属于陈先生，他向商人募集捐款以维持消防队的运作。

10月11日上午，日本海军力量增加了三艘巡洋舰：“长良”号（NAGARA）、“川内”号（SENDAI）和“龙田”号（JINTSU）。这三艘舰艇属于第一战队（横须贺）第八分队。“长良”号排水量5,100吨，航速33节。装备有7门140毫米火炮，两门76毫米高射炮，2挺机枪和8具533毫米鱼雷发射管，船员438人。另外两艘舰艇是“长良”号的改型，拥有相同的武装。每艘船携带一架通过弹射系统起飞的的水上飞机。

今早在港的舰艇如下：

巡洋舰“出云”号（大川中将）；“川内”号（神津少将）以及“龙田”号和“长良”号；第22水雷队的驱逐舰“文月”号、“长月”号和“皐月”号，以及第3水雷队的“汐风”号和“岛风”号，共计四艘巡洋舰和五艘驱逐舰。

members and volunteers ordering them to report for duty every
evening at their respective offices and confine themselves to
barracks during the night.
It is reported that the Chinese Authorities have decided
upon the following plan in case of any attempt made by the
Japanese to take action against Chinese controlled territory :-
1) That all lights on streets be extinguished at once.
2) That members of Paoantui be responsible for the defence of
the first line; the Chinese Police, the 2nd line, with
members of Merchant Volunteer Corps in reserve.
Soldiers in plain clothes arrive at Quinsan
It is reported that during the night of October 9/10
one thousand soldiers in plain clothes arrived at Quinsan from
Soochow. On the morning of October 10, the Chinese Police
at Quinsan secretly instructed all house owners to make room
on their premises for the accommodation of soldiers.
Two Chinese arrested for loitering at the Civic Centre on Oct.10
At 10.45 a.m. October 10, two Chinese were taken into
custody by the Chinese Police at the Civic Centre for loitering
while the Shanghai City Government celebrations of the Double
Tenth Festival were in progress. These two persons who were
released at 5.30 p.m. the same day on security gave the
following names :-
Li Kuo-zu (李國柱 ), who claimed to be an ex-gateman
of the Wayside Police Station.
Chang Feng-ting (張鳳亭 ).

TRANSLATION OF A FRENCH POLICE REPORT DATED OCTOBER 9, 1936.

1330/3
9.30 a.m. October 9, 1936.

Subject: Situation in the Settlement.
Movement of Japanese troops.
Movement of Chinese troops.

Reference: Murder of Japanese Marine TAKINATO.

The situation remains the same as it was yesterday.
In a communication addressed to the Japanese Authorities, the Mayor of Greater Shanghai has requested the withdrawal from Chapei of all Japanese posts and patrols.
A new consignment of silver (2,035 cases - $10,165,000) for Hongkong left on October 7 on the s.s. "Empress of Canada."
It is reported that on the Shanghai Nanking Line, two armoured trains - Nos. 5 and 7 - are to be seen, one at Nanking and one at Wusih.
Yesterday the local Tangpu rented premises at No. 8 Route Vallen. A part of the archives of the local Kuomintang have been sent to this address. The "land office" of the Chinese Municipality has rented premises at 370 Route de Sioyes and has had its archives shifted there.
During the 8th-9th inst. the number of removals from Chapei was very important. Proceeding in a southerly direction over the bridges of the Soochow Creek, 460 trucks, 964 automobiles, 8350 rickshas, 983 wheelbarrows and 213 various vehicles loaded with furniture and trunks were seen.
In order to put a stop to rumours which are prevalent, the Garrison Commander's office has had inserted in all this morning's newspapers, instructions to the effect that anyone who spreads stories of an alarmist nature will be arrested and tried according to military law.

SALLY.

1330/3
1936年10月9日上午9时30分。

主题：租界局势。
日军调动。
华军调动。

参考：日本海军陆战队士兵 TAKINATO 被杀案。

局势与昨日相同。
大上海市长在向日本当局发出的照会中，要求撤出闸北的所有日本哨所和巡逻队。
一批新的白银（2,035箱 - 10,165,000美元）运往香港，已于10月7日由“加拿大皇后”号轮船运出。
据报，在沪宁线上可以看到两列装甲列车——第5号和第7号，一列在南京，一列在无锡。
昨天，当地党部租用了瓦伦路（Route Vallen）8号的房屋。国民党地方党部的一部分档案已送往该地址。中国市政当局的“地政局”租用了西爱咸斯路（Route de Sioyes）370号的房屋，并将档案移往此处。
在8日至9日期间，从闸北搬离的数量非常大。向南经过苏州河桥梁，可见460辆卡车、964辆汽车、8350辆人力车、983辆独轮车和213辆各种车辆，装载着家具和箱子。
为了制止流行的谣言，卫戍司令部在今早的所有报纸上刊登了指令，称任何散布恐慌性质故事的人将被逮捕并按军法审判。

SALLY.

4 p.m. October 9, 1936.

1331/8
Subject: Transfer to the French Concession of archives
of certain Chinese administrations.
Reference: Report 1330/8 of October 9, 1936.
Assassination of Japanese marine TAMIMATO.

As a result of the present tense situation between
China and Japan, the Shanghai City Government has taken the
opportunity of transferring to the French Concession certain
archives.

In this connection, the following premises have been
rented:

201 Route de Boissezon for the archives of the Municipality
of Greater Shanghai. The transfer had not been made up till
October 9, 1936.

641 Avenue Foch for the archives of the Bureau of Public
Safety. Transfer not made by October 9.

370 Route de Sioyes for the archives of the "land office"
of the Municipality of Greater Shanghai. Transfer finished.

8 Route Vallen for the archives of the local Kuomintang.
Transfer not completed by October 9.

44 Joffre Terrace for the archives of the Public Works Dept.
Transfer finished.

On the other hand, the three state banks have had
their non-negotiable bills and their stocks of unnumbered
banknotes transferred to the strong rooms of the I.S.S., Ave.
Edward VII and to the Banque Franco-Chinoise, French Bund.

Further, the Minister of Communications is endeavouring
to locate premises in the French Concession for the purpose
of housing a short-wave radio station.

Signed: SARLY.

Translation of French Police Report dated October 8, 1936
9 a.m.

Situation in the International Settlement
Movement of Japanese troops
Movement of Chinese troops

The panic caused by the anxiety reigning among the population of Chapei was reflected yesterday in the great number of removals .

The placing of a net-work of barbed wire in the neighbourhood of the North Railway Station during the evening still added to the panic. Note : The Chinese authorities say that this network of barbed wire has been set up in order to facilitate the protection of Japanese notabilities who have to take the train at the North Station.

During the afternoon and evening, 75 trucks, 225 automobiles, 2677 rickshas, 14 small carts, 196 hand-trucks and 44 different vehicles laden with trunks and articles of furniture were observed crossing the various bridges of Soochow Creek.

Dismantling off the machines in the workshops at Woosung of the Shanghai-Nanking line is almost completed. An important quantity of material has already been transferred to Changchow - 163 kilometres from Shanghai.

At Chapei, the Pao Zeu Shan Tsang Benevolent Society, which has a stock of coffins at No.210 Pao Zeu Road, has evacuated the premises. Now 200 soldiers of the 2nd Regiment charged with the maintenance of peace are billeted there. This has induced factories in Chapei to transport into the Concessions their raw materials and manufactured goods which they do not strictly need.

By order of the local government, the omnibus companies are keeping a stand-by service during the night, so as to permit rapid evacuation of the material. Driver not on duty must not leave the depots.

On the Japanese side there is nothing important to report.

Since yesterday Japanese sailors have been installing a telephone wire in Gordon Road (Japan China S and W Co Mills) towards Robison Road.

Furthermore they have completed the following lines :

1/ From the barracks to Post No.641 N. Szechuen Road,
2/ do to Post No.400 Miller Road,
3/ do to Post No.221 Eu Yang Rd (near Dixwell Road),
4/ do to Chimei Road Post (near Dixwell Road),
5/ de to Rokusen Garden hutments,
6/ de to O.S.K. Wharf.

The first five lines are on outside roads, the last in the International Settlement.

At 3.45 p.m. yesterday five lorries transporting approx. 200 marines were seen entering the Japanese barracks at N.Szechuen Road. It is not known whether this was a relief or a detachment disembarked from vessels in the roadstead.

1936年10月8日法国警方报告译文
上午9时

国际租界局势
日军调动
华军调动

闸北居民中弥漫的焦虑引起的恐慌，昨日的搬迁数量之多反映了这一点。

傍晚在北火车站附近架设铁丝网网阵，进一步加剧了恐慌。注：中国当局称，架设此铁丝网阵是为了便于保护必须在北站乘车的日本要人。

下午和晚间，观察到75辆卡车、225辆汽车、2677辆人力车、14辆小板车、196辆手推车和44辆其他车辆装载着箱子和家具穿过苏州河的各座桥梁。

沪宁线吴淞车间的机器拆卸工作已基本完成。大量物资已转移至常州——距上海163公里。

在闸北，拥有棺材库存的宝珠山藏善会（音译，位于宝珠路210号）已撤离该处。现在，负责维持治安的第二团的200名士兵宿营于此。这促使闸北的工厂将其非严格需要的原材料和制成品运入租界。

根据地方政府的命令，公共汽车公司在夜间保持待命服务，以便快速疏散物资。不当班的司机不得离开车场。

日方方面无重要情况可报。

自昨天以来，日本水兵一直在戈登路（日华纱厂）向罗宾森路方向安装电话线。

此外，他们已完成以下线路：

1/ 从兵营至北四川路641号哨所，
2/ 同上至米勒路（今海拉尔路）400号哨所，
3/ 同上至欧阳路221号哨所（近狄克威路），
4/ 同上至吉美路哨所（近狄克威路），
5/ 同上至六仙花园棚屋，
6/ 同上至大阪商船会社码头。

前五条线路位于外部道路，最后一条位于国际租界内。

昨天下午3时45分，五辆卡车运送约200名海军陆战队士兵进入北四川路的日本兵营。尚不清楚这是换防还是从锚地船只上下来的分遣队。

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
S.1, Special Branch 61616161/
REPORT
Date October 8, 19 36.
Subject Chinese Military Situation along Nanking-Shanghai Line.
Made by D.I. Fan Lien-pih Forwarded by [Signature]

Since the unfavourable development in the Sino-
Japanese negotiations on September 23 the Chinese Authorities
have commenced to make urgent preparations for a possible
outbreak of a war between Japan and China. Troops stationed
along the Nanking-Shanghai Railway Line have been increased
during the past fortnight from 30,000 (including 10,000
soldiers undergoing a refresher course in the Military
Academy at Nanking) to about 70,000. In addition to these,
troops numbering about 30,000 are stationed in neighbouring
cities ready to be transferred at any moment either by train
or bus. Statistics showing the disposition of troops,
their units and strength are attached as an appendix.

The nearest city to Shanghai along the Nanking-
Shanghai Railway Line where troops are stationed is Wei Ting
(唯亭 ), approximately 42 miles from the Shanghai North
Station, where the headquarters of the 108th Brigade, 36th
Division, only recently transferred from Fokien via Hangchow,
are at present located.

The Nanking-Shanghai Railway Line from Wei-ting to
Changchow is guarded by the 36th Division (10,000) and the
6th Regiment of the Military Police (1,500) with headquarters
at Soochow.

Beyond Changchow, the line is guarded by members
of the 4 regiments of the Kiangsu Peace Preservation Corps
(6,000) with headquarters at Chinkiang.

From Chinkiang westward to Nanking, and in Nanking
itself, there are about 30,000 troops including 10,000 of
the 88th Division.

The Northern sector of the Soochow-Kashing Railway

自9月23日中日谈判出现不利进展以来，中国当局已开始紧急准备应对可能爆发的中日战争。过去两周，驻扎在沪宁铁路沿线的部队已从30,000人（包括10,000名在南京军校接受复训的士兵）增加到约70,000人。除此之外，约有30,000名部队驻扎在邻近城市，随时准备通过火车或巴士转移。显示部队部署、单位和兵力的统计数据作为附录附上。

沪宁铁路线上离上海最近且有部队驻扎的城市是唯亭，距上海北站约42英里，目前第36师第108旅的总部设在此处，该旅最近刚从福建经杭州调来。

从唯亭到常州的沪宁铁路线由第36师（10,000人）和宪兵第六团（1,500人）守卫，总部设在苏州。

常州以西，该线由江苏保安团四个团的成员（6,000人）守卫，总部设在镇江。

从镇江向西至南京，以及在南京市内，约有30,000名部队，其中包括第88师的10,000人。

Changshu and its vicinity are guarded by the 87th

Besides these units, the 11th Division and the
14th Division stationed at Ishing are in readiness for
transfer to the railway zone, and this transfer can be
easily effected by means of the bus route on the Wusieh-
Ishing Highway.
In view of the seriousness of the present situation,
the Ministry of War has issued instructions to all armies,
emphasizing the importance of keeping secret the movements
and whereabouts of troops. Consequently the transfer of
troops in almost all cases has taken place during the night
and upon arrival at a destination, the troops select their
barracks in secluded places, avoiding streets or business
centres.
The National Government has been speeding up
emergency preparations. The majority of the hills surrounding
Nanking such as Tsz Ching San (紫金山), Yui Hwa Tai (雨花台),
Chi Ming Dz (雞鳴寺) and Tong San (湯山) have all been
turned into fortified zones, admission to these places being
strictly prohibited to unauthorized persons.
Bases for anti-aircraft guns have been constructed
on the city wall of the capital, although no guns have
actually been placed there yet. It is learned that the
Ministry of War and the General Staff have secretly ordered
dugouts to be constructed to be used when necessary, and a

Translation of French Police Intelligence Report
dated October 7, 1936. 6.30 p.m.

Report No. 1327/S

Subject:- Situation in the International Concession.
Movements of Japanese troops
Movements of Chinese troops.

Reference:- Murder of Japanese marine Taminato.

On account of rumours which were circulating in Chapei
to-day regarding the possibility of rupture of the negotiations
opened in Nanking this afternoon between Chinese and Japanese
representatives, the exodus of inhabitants of Chapei and vicinity
has been resumed this afternoon. The Chinese Police attempted
to interfere ╳, but were unable to re-establish the confidence.
Moreover, certain new facts indicate that the situation which
appeared to be calming down, becomes again serious.

In a secret order issued this morning General Tsai Ching
Chum, Chief of the Chinese Police, is reported to have ordered
all ranks under his command to keep in touch with their
respective places of service and to be ready to march at the
first order. The Police have been standing by at their
respective stations since September 23.

On the other hand the Bureau of Public Safety rented House
No. 641 Avenue Foch (near the Mercier-Foch intersection) today
either for the purpose of establishing an information centre
there or for transferring to this place a part of archives.

The Municipal Police are in possession of information
according to which the Chinese military and civil authorities
have received instructions to be followed in the event of
rupture of the Sino-Japanese negotiations. According to
these instructions, the local Chinese authorities should, in
the event of such rupture being followed by acts of hostility
in the zone under the Chinese administration, offer resistance
for several hours in order that reinforcements might be sent
down from the nearest bases situated on the Shanghai-Nanking
and Shanghai-Hangchow railways. Be it as it may, grenades
were issued to the reserve units (four companies) of the
Chinese Police as well as to various units of the Peace
Preservation Corps.

1936年10月7日下午6:30法国警察情报报告译文

报告编号 1327/S

主题：- 国际租界局势。
日军动向
中国军队动向。

参考：- 日本海军陆战队员田港（Taminato）被杀案。

由于今天闸北流传着关于今天下午在南京开始的中日代表谈判可能破裂的谣言，闸北及周边居民的撤离今天下午再次开始。中国警察试图干预 ╳，但未能恢复民众的信心。此外，某些新的事实表明，看似正在缓和的局势再次变得严峻。

据报道，中国警察局长蔡劲军将军今早发布了一道秘密命令，命令其麾下所有人员与各自的服务地点保持联系，并随时准备接到第一道命令即出发。自9月23日以来，警察一直在各自的岗位待命。

另一方面，公共安全局今天租下了霞飞路641号房屋（靠近梅西埃-霞飞路口），要么是为了在那里建立信息中心，要么是为了将部分档案转移至此。

市警察局掌握的情报显示，中国军方和民政当局已收到在中日谈判破裂情况下应遵循的指令。根据这些指令，如果谈判破裂随后在中国管辖区发生敌对行动，当地中国当局应抵抗数小时，以便从位于京沪和沪杭铁路线上的最近基地派遣增援部队。无论如何，手榴弹已发放给中国警察的预备队（四个连）以及保安队的各个单位。

page_data.en:
-2-

Coolies are reported to be employed by the Police and
the Peace Preservation Corps for preparing sand-bags and
transferable barbed wire barricades.

Among other things, we are informed that the units of
Peace Preservation Corps have been secretly concentrated in
various points presenting strategic advantages in the city
and Chapei, as well as in the vicinity including Tahchang.

The Headquarters of the 2nd Regiment of the Peace
Preservation Corps have been transferred from Chapei to Nantao
where they now occupy the premises of the military club where
the Headquarters of the 1st Regiment were already located.

The men of the units transferred are reported to have
received orders to make themselves as little conspicuous as
possible and to take all precautions against spies. That is
why the parts of Chapei occupied by members of the two regiments
of the Peace Preservation Corps are closed to pedestrian
traffic and to foreigners.

As to the Japanese, it is reported that 40 marines with
200 cases of arms and ammunition and 6 lorries have been
installed at 62 Robison Road, in the Western District, where
Mills No.1 and 2 of the Nagai Wata Kaisha are situated.

The torpedo boat MINAZAKI of the 22nd squadron left this
afternoon for an unknown destination.

Finally, we are informed that an agreement has been
reached during this afternoon between the Japanese and General
SUNG CHE YUAN, Chairman of the Hopei and Charhar Political
Council, on the subject of the "Economic Protectorate" demanded
by the Japanese over North China.
page_data.zh:
-2-

据报，警察与保安队雇用苦力准备沙袋及可移动的铁丝网路障。

此外，我们获悉，保安队各部已秘密集结于上海市内及闸北具有战略优势的各据点，以及包括大场在内的周边地区。

保安队第二团总部已由闸北迁至南市，目前占据第一团总部所在的军人俱乐部 premises。

据报，调防部队的人员已接到命令，要求尽可能不引人注目，并采取一切防范措施以防间谍。因此，由保安队两个团占领的闸北部分地区已禁止行人通行，并禁止外国人进入。

关于日本人，据报40名海军陆战队员携带200箱武器弹药及6辆卡车，已进驻西区罗别根路62号，该处为永泰纱厂（Nagai Wata Kaisha）第一、二厂所在地。

第二十二鱼雷艇队的“水无月”号（MINAZAKI）于今日下午驶离，目的地不明。

最后，我们获悉，日本人与冀察政务委员会委员长宋哲元将军于今日下午就日本要求的华北“经济保护权”问题达成协议。

REPORT
File No. f.552
7 - 10 - 36.
Date October. 7. 19 36.
Subject Present Political Situation.
Made by D. S. McKeown Forwarded by (签名)
With regard to the present tension in Sino - Japanese
relations, enquiries from various sources reveal the following
situation.
At the beginning of September 1936, the Japanese
submitted a number of demands to the Chinese Foreign Minister
at Nanking which included one to the effect that Japanese
marines should be stationed at various places in the Yangtsze
valley. To this demand a reply was given that discussions on
this point could only be held when the Shanghai agreement
concluded in 1932 was revoked.
Another demand that there should be a preferential
tariff for Japanese goods coming into China was met with the
reply that this demand would not be discussed until the
smuggling in which Japanese subjects are engaged ceased entirely.
The article which appeared in the Evening Post on September 30.
(attached) has some element of truth. However the Chinese
Government did not submit a series of demands to the Japanese
Ambassador, but only conditions to each demand made.
Subsequently it is reported, the Japanese authorities formulated
a set of nine demands and stipulated that the Chinese Authorities
should consider and give a separate reply to each demand. To
this the Chinese Authorities replied that that they would consider
the demands in toto and accept or reject them in their entirety.
The Japanese however refused to agree to this procedure. From
this it would appear that the Japanese are of the opinion that
if the demands were considered separately, the more important
ones would be accepted, and the others rejected, while they
are convinced that if the demands are considered in toto, a
negative answer will be given. Hence an impasse has arisen.
（左侧批注：13 Oct. 1936）

7 - 10 - 36.
日期 1936年10月7日。
主题 当前政治局势。
撰写人 D. S. McKeown 转呈人 (签名)

鉴于中日关系的当前紧张局势，来自各方渠道的调查揭示了以下情况。

1936年9月初，日本向南京的中国外交部长提出了一系列要求，其中包括一项要求，即日本海军陆战队应驻扎在长江流域的各个地点。对此要求的答复是，只有在废除1932年达成的《上海协定》后，才能就此问题进行讨论。

另一项要求是对进入中国的日本商品给予优惠关税，对此的答复是，在日本侨民从事的走私活动完全停止之前，不会讨论此项要求。9月30日《字林西报》刊登的文章（附后）包含部分事实。然而，中国政府并未向日本大使提出一系列要求，而只是针对每一项要求提出了条件。

随后据报，日本当局制定了九项要求，并规定中国当局应考虑并对每一项要求分别作出答复。对此，中国当局答复称，他们将整体考虑这些要求，并全部接受或全部拒绝。然而，日本方面拒绝同意此程序。由此看来，日本方面认为，如果单独考虑各项要求，较重要的要求会被接受，而其他要求会被拒绝；而他们确信，如果整体考虑这些要求，将会得到否定的答复。因此，僵局由此产生。
（左侧批注：1936年10月13日）

the arrival of Mr. Kuwujima, special courier of the Japanese
Foreign Office, has done little to relieve a tense situation.
According to well informed Chinese circles, Mr. Kuwujima
does not intend to alter the tone of the Japanese demands, and
has declared that the policy of Japan in dealing with China
will remain unchanged during the forthcoming negotiations.
Mr. Kuwujima is due to negotiate with either General Chiang
Kai-shek or General Chang Chun, the Foreign Minister,
to-morrow, October 8. Chinese political circles are
taking a pessimistic view of the forthcoming negotiations.
The removal of City Government offices, money from the larger
local Chinese banks, and the mobilization of the Peace
Preservation Corps lead to the opinion that the result of the
forthcoming negotiations will not be considered satisfactory
by the Japanese, and that repercussions will be felt in
Shanghai. Again, it is reliably reported that the hitherto
discontented Southern Clique only agreed to follow Nanking
provided that direct action was taken against the Japanese,
and on this condition consented to place the whole of their
armies and resources at the disposal of the Nanking Authorities.
It is generally feared that the negotiations at
Nanking between Mr. Kuwujima and General Chang Chun will be
deadlocked immediately, and that the already tense situation
will develop unfavourably during the next few days.
J M Brown
D. S.
Officer i/c Special Branch.

日本外务省特使久岛先生（Mr. Kuwujima，音译）的到来对缓解紧张局势作用甚微。据消息灵通的中国人士称，久岛先生无意改变日本要求的基调，并宣称在接下来的谈判中，日本对华政策将保持不变。久岛先生定于明日，即10月8日，与蒋介石将军或外交部长张群将军进行谈判。中国政界对即将到来的谈判持悲观态度。市政府机关的撤离、从大型本地华商银行转移资金，以及保安队的动员，导致人们认为即将到来的谈判结果将不会被日本方面视为满意，且上海将感受到其反响。此外，有可靠消息称，此前一直不满的西南派系仅同意在采取对日直接行动的前提下追随南京政府，并在此条件下同意将其全部军队和资源交由南京当局支配。

人们普遍担心，久岛先生与张群将军在南京的谈判将立即陷入僵局，且本已紧张的局势将在未来几天内恶化。
J M Brown
D. S.
特别科科长。

The Shanghai Evening Post & Mercury, Wednesday, September 30, 1936    16941

Chinese Counter With Demands
On Japan, Astounding Kawagoe;
Withdrawal Of Troops Required

Chiang Formulates New
Objective; Naval Landing
Party Exit On Program

Demands Include Fengtai Troop Withdrawal;
Suppression Of Activities Carried On By Ronins,
End Of Smuggling, Free Hand In Hopei.

Local Paoantui Promised Support

Taking a leaf out of the Japanese book, China has countered Japanese demands by presenting a set of her own, according to information from Nanking to The Shanghai Evening Post today.

The Chinese demands upon Japan are said to have been formulated and presented following Ambassador Kawagoe's submission of Japanese demands to Foreign Minister Chang Chun.

TALKED WITH LI
General Chiang Kai-shek is said to have discussed the Japanese requirements personally with General Li Tsung-jen in the south, and both leaders collaborated in framing the counter-demands which were telegraphed north and subsequently presented by General Chang Chun. This procedure was in accordance with terms of the peace agreement with the Southwest leaders, according to information here.

In their major aspects the Chinese demands are said to be as follows:
- Withdraw Landing Parties
Agreement to keep all Japanese landing-parties from Chinese soil.
- Suppression of activities of "Ronin" in general, and smuggling in particular.
- Withdrawal of Japanese troops from Fengtai near Peiping.
- Achievement of a Sino-Japanese understanding so that China can have a free hand in dealing with the "East Hopei autonomous" regime.

Envoys Astonished
When General Chang presented these demands to Mr. Kawagoe, it is reported, the Japanese envoy arose and stood with an appearance of consternation. The foreign minister immediately said that he quite understood no reply could be made forthwith, but that the Chinese side desired that its wishes be made known at once to the Japanese government and a full reply be obtained in due course.

It is said that this step in the conferences accounted for the reports that Mr. Kawagoe desired to terminate his conversations with the foreign minister and instead to open discussion with General Chiang.

Attitude Stiffens
General Chiang may consent to receive a call from Mr. Kawagoe, it was reported today, but it was generally believed that he would decline to discuss Sino-Japanese negotiations. In the event that Mr. Kawagoe sought to bring the subject up, it was understood General Chiang would refer him back to the foreign Minister.

In connection with the Shanghai situation it was reported from Nanking that instruction had been given the local "pao an tui" (protection and peace corps) promptly to resist any Japanese efforts to send armed forces into Chinese territory, with a promise that reinforcements would be available within a few hours if any clash occurred.

Chiang In Kuling
General Chiang Kai-shek is now in Kuling and is expected to return to Nanking within one week, according to Mr. Chen Pu-lei, personal secretary of the generalissimo.

Officials circles in Nanking are viewing the Sino-Japanese tension with great concern and numerous conferences have been held to discuss China's policy in facing the Japanese demands, which among other things, include the autonomy of the five North China provinces, right to station troops at Yangtze ports and on Hainan Island, to inspect textbooks and schools, and economic cooperation.

Relations Studied
The Executive Yuan session yesterday lasted for about three hours during which Sino-Japanese relations were closely studied. According to Japanese reports, high government officials were divided on their policies towards the Japanese demands. While General Chang Chun and a group of others are said to have advocated a more conciliatory policy, a group of high officials suggested a stronger policy towards Japan, Japanese reports claimed.

Immediately following the conference, Mr. Sun Fo, president of the Legislative Yuan, who did not participate in the Executive Yuan session, gave a tiffin party at his Nanking residence. Those attended included Generals Feng Yu-hsiang, Li Lieh-chung, Ho Ying-ching, Chu Pei-te, Dr. H. H. Kung, Mr. Yih Chu-chang and Mr. Liang Ho-chao. General Chang Chun was absent. It is said that they discussed Sino-Japanese relations.

Nanking reports also stated that the Waichiaopu has received a full text of Mr. Hachiro Arita's statement recently given foreign correspondents at the Gaimusho. The Waichiaopu is closely studying the statement and may issue a statement in reply to Mr. Arita's outbursts when necessary.

Chang Leaving
(Reuter's Agency)
NANKING, Sept. 29.—General Chang Chun, Minister for Foreign Affairs, is leaving for Kuling by air tomorrow to call on General Chiang Kai-shek, president of the Executive Yuan, who has arrived there from Nanchang.

While official confirmation is lacking, the belief is gaining ground that direct negotiations between the Generalissimo and Mr. S. Kawagoe, the Japanese Ambassador to China, are improbable, the Chinese authorities maintaining that General Chang Chun in fully capable of representing the Chinese Government.

Even though an interview may be arranged between the Japanese Ambassador and General Chiang Kai-shek, actual negotiations, it is stated, must be conducted through General Chang Chun.

"Critical Stage"
(Reuter's Agency)
NANKING, Sept. 29.—Most of the Chinese newspapers here comment at length on the statement made yesterday by Mr. Arita, the Japanese Foreign Minister, concerning Japan's attitude towards China in consequence of the recent "incidents."

Generally speaking, they reached two conclusions, first, that Sino-Japanese relations have reached a critical stage; secondly, that critical though the situation may be, Japan is still hopeful of settling matters through diplomatic channels.

《字林西报》，1936年9月30日，星期三    16941

中方以要求回击日本，令川越震惊；
要求撤军

蒋介石制定新目标；
海军陆战队撤离列入议程

要求包括丰台撤军；
镇压浪人活动，
结束走私，在河北拥有行动自由。

地方保安团获承诺支持

据今日南京向《字林西报》提供的消息，中国效仿日本的做法，通过提出自己的一套要求来回应日本的要求。

据悉，在中方提出对日要求之前，川越大使已向外交部长张群提交了日本的要求。

与李宗仁会谈

据悉，蒋介石将军在南方亲自与李宗仁将军讨论了日本的要求，两位领导人共同制定了反要求，随后电告北方，并由张群将军正式提出。据此处消息，此程序符合与西南领导人的和平协议条款。

据悉，中方要求的主要内容如下：
- 撤离登陆部队
达成协议，阻止所有日本登陆部队进入中国领土。
- 全面镇压“浪人”活动，特别是走私活动。
- 日军从北平附近的丰台撤军。
- 达成中日谅解，以便中国在处理“冀东自治”政权时拥有行动自由。

使节震惊

据报道，当张群将军向川越先生提出这些要求时，日本使节起身站立，面露惊愕。外交部长立即表示，他完全理解无法立即作出答复，但中方希望将其意愿立即告知日本政府，并在适当时候获得全面答复。

据说，会议中的这一举动解释了有关川越先生希望终止与外交部长的谈话，转而与蒋介石将军开启讨论的报道。

态度强硬

今日有报道称，蒋介石将军可能会同意接受川越先生的拜访，但普遍认为他将拒绝讨论中日谈判。万一川越先生试图提起该话题，据悉蒋将军会将此事推回给外交部长处理。

关于上海局势，据南京报道，已指示当地“保安团”迅速抵抗任何日本向中国领土派遣武装力量的企图，并承诺一旦发生冲突，几小时内即可提供增援。

蒋介石在庐山

据委员长私人秘书陈布雷先生称，蒋介石将军目前在庐山，预计一周内返回南京。

南京官场对中日紧张局势深感忧虑，并举行了多次会议讨论中国面对日本要求时的政策，这些要求除其他事项外，包括华北五省自治、在长江港口和海南岛驻军的权利、检查教科书和学校，以及经济合作。

研究关系

昨日行政院会议持续约三小时，期间密切研究了中日关系。据日本方面报道，政府高官在对日要求的政策上存在分歧。据日本方面声称，虽然张群将军及其他一些人据说主张采取更缓和的政策，但另一批高官建议对日本采取更强硬的政策。

会议结束后，未参加行政院会议的立法院院长孙科先生在其南京寓所举行午宴。出席者包括冯玉祥、李烈钧、何应钦、朱培德将军，孔祥熙博士，以及叶楚伧先生和梁寒操先生。张群将军缺席。据说他们讨论了中日关系。

南京方面还称，外交部已收到有田八郎先生近期在外务省向外国记者发表的声明全文。外交部正在仔细研究该声明，并可能在必要时发表声明以回应有田先生的激烈言论。

张群离京
（路透社）
南京，9月29日。—外交部长张群将军将于明日乘飞机前往庐山，拜会已从南昌抵达那里的行政院院长蒋介石将军。

虽然缺乏官方证实，但一种观点日益盛行，即委员长与日本驻华大使川越茂先生之间的直接谈判不太可能，中国当局坚持认为张群将军完全有能力代表中国政府。

即使日本大使与蒋介石将军之间安排了会晤，据悉，实际谈判必须通过张群将军进行。

“关键阶段”
（路透社）
南京，9月29日。—此地大多数中文报纸详细评论了日本外相有田先生昨日就日本因近期“事件”而对华态度所作的声明。

总体而言，它们得出两个结论：第一，中日关系已达到关键阶段；第二，尽管局势危急，日本仍希望通过外交渠道解决问题。

Translation of French Police Intelligence Report
dated October 7, 1936.    6.30 p.m.

Report No. 1327/S

Subject:- Situation in the International Concession.
Movements of Japanese troops
Movements of Chinese troops.

Reference:- Murder of Japanese marine Taminato.

On account of rumours which were circulating in Chapei
to-day regarding the possibility of rupture of the negotiations
opened in Nanking this afternoon between Chinese and Japanese
representatives, the exodus of inhabitants of Chapei and vicinity
has been resumed this afternoon. The Chinese Police attempted
to interfere it, but were unable to re-establish the confidence.
Moreover, certain new facts indicate that the situation which
appeared to be calming down, becomes again serious.

In a secret order issued this morning General Tsai Ching
Chum, Chief of the Chinese Police, is reported to have ordered
all ranks under his command to keep in touch with their
respective places of service and to be ready to march at the
first order. The Police have been standing by at their
respective stations since September 23.

On the other hand the Bureau of Public Safety rented House
No. 641 Avenue Foch (near the Mercier-Foch intersection) today
either for the purpose of establishing an information centre
there or for transferring to this place a part of archives.

The Municipal Police are in possession of information
according to which the Chinese military and civil authorities
have received instructions to be followed in the event of
rupture of the Sino-Japanese negotiations. According to
these instructions, the local Chinese authorities should, in
the event of such rupture being followed by acts of hostility
in the zone under the Chinese administration, offer resistance
for several hours in order that reinforcements might be sent
down from the nearest bases situated on the Shanghai-Nanking
and Shanghai-Hangchow railways. Be it as it may, grenades
were issued to the reserve units (four companies) of the
Chinese Police as well as to various units of the Peace
Preservation Corps.

1936年10月7日下午6时30分法国警务情报报告译文

第1327/S号报告

主题：国际租界局势。
日军调动
华军调动。

参考事项：日本海军陆战队员田港（Taminato）被杀案。

由于今日闸北流传着关于今天下午在南京举行的中日代表谈判可能破裂的谣言，闸北及附近居民的撤离行动于今日下午重新开始。中国警察试图加以干涉，但未能恢复民众的信心。此外，某些新近发生的事实表明，原本看似平息的局势再次变得严峻。

据报，中国警察局长蔡劲军将军在今早发布的一道秘密命令中，已令其麾下所有人员与各自服役地点保持联系，并准备随时奉命出发。自9月23日以来，警察一直驻守在各自的警局待命。

另一方面，公安局今日租下了福煦路641号（靠近麦赛尔福煦路口），旨在要么在此设立一个情报中心，要么将部分档案转移至此。

工部局警务处掌握的情报显示，中国军方和民政当局已收到在中日谈判破裂情况下需遵循的指令。根据这些指令，一旦谈判破裂并随之在中国管辖区内发生敌对行动，当地中国当局应抵抗数小时，以便从位于沪宁铁路和沪杭铁路沿线最近的基地派遣增援部队。无论如何，手榴弹已发放给中国警察的后备部队（四个连）以及保安总队的各个分队。

page_data.en:
-2-

Coolies are reported to be employed by the Police and
the Peace Preservation Corps for preparing sand-bags and
transferable barbed wire barricades.

Among other things, we are informed that the units of
Peace Preservation Corps have been secretly concentrated in
various points presenting strategic advantages in the city
and Chapei, as well as in the vicinity including Tahchang.

The Headquarters of the 2nd Regiment of the Peace
Preservation Corps have been transferred from Chapei to Nantao
where they now occupy the premises of the military club where
the Headquarters of the 1st Regiment were already located.

The men of the units transferred are reported to have
received orders to make themselves as little conspicuous as
possible and to take all precautions against spies. That is
why the parts of Chapei occupied by members of the two regiments
of the Peace Preservation Corps are closed to pedestrian
traffic and to foreigners.

As to the Japanese, it is reported that 40 marines with
200 cases of arms and ammunition and 6 lorries have been
installed at 62 Robison Road, in the Western District, where
Mills No.1 and 2 of the Nagai Wata Kaisha are situated.

The torpedo boat MINAZAKI of the 22nd squadron left this
afternoon for an unknown destination.

Finally, we are informed that an agreement has been
reached during this afternoon between the Japanese and General
SUNG CHE YUAN, Chairman of the Hopei and Charhar Political
Council, on the subject of the "Economic Protectorate" demanded
by the Japanese over North China.
page_data.zh:
-2-

据报，警察和保安总队雇用苦力准备沙袋和可移动的铁丝网路障。

此外，我们获悉，保安总队的各分队已秘密集结在上海市区、闸北以及包括大场在内的周边具有战略优势的各个地点。

保安总队第二团总部已从闸北迁至南市，目前占据军人俱乐部的房舍，第一团总部此前已设于此。

据报，调防部队的士兵已接到命令，要求尽可能不引人注目，并采取一切防范措施以防间谍。因此，由保安总队两个团的成员占领的闸北部分地区已禁止行人通行，并禁止外国人进入。

至于日本人，据报有40名海军陆战队员携带200箱武器弹药和6辆卡车，进驻了位于西区罗宾森路62号的永泰纱厂一厂和二厂所在地。

第二十二鱼雷艇队的“水无月”号（MINAZAKI）鱼雷艇于今日下午驶往未知目的地。

最后，我们获悉，日本人与冀察政务委员会委员长宋哲元将军就日本要求的华北“经济保护权”一事，于今日下午达成了协议。

上海公共租界工部局警务处。
档案编号 7532
S.1，特务科 84/36
报告
日期：1936年10月7日。
主题（全称）：公安局警察被限制在营房内。

公安局于10月6日晚10时发布了一项机密指令，规定所有警员必须留在营房内，并穿着制服睡觉，以便随时应对任何紧急情况。同日晚上8时，隶属于公安局各分局的休班侦探接到指令，前往市内蓬莱路的总局报到，并在那里过夜。

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.    File No............
Confidential    Special Branch Section,
REPORT    Date...October...7...19 36.
Subject...Removal of documents of Shanghai City Government to French Concession.

Made by....................and....................Forwarded by...Supt. Tan Shao Liang.

A report has been received from a fairly reliable
source that all important documents belonging to the Bureau
of Public Safety have been removed to the home of Zia Pao-sung
(notorious character of French Concession and a former mafoo)
near the corner of Rue Cardinal Mercier and Avenue Foch,
and those from the City Government offices (Kiangwan) to the
Chinese Municipal Club, Route Ferguson.

The same informer narrated that the local military
and civil officials are said to have received orders from
Nanking to resist in the event of Sino-Japanese negotiations
ending in deadlock and Japanese marines opening hostilities
in Chinese territory and to hold this area for several hours
pending reinforcements from the nearest points along the
Nanking-Shanghai and Shanghai-Hangchow Railways.

Grenades are reported to have been issued to members
of the Reserve Units of the Bureau of Public Safety and Pao An Tui
(Peace Preservation Corps) and workmen have been employed
to make barbed wire barricades and sand bags quietly without
being observed by outsiders.

Tan Shao Liang
Superintendent.
Officer i/c Special Branch.    [Signature]

据相当可靠的消息来源报告，属于公安局的所有重要文件已被转移至法租界 notorious character（著名人物/劣迹昭著者）兼前马夫夏宝松（Zia Pao-sung）的家中，该处位于麦赛尔神父路与福煦路转角附近；而来自市政府办公室（江湾）的文件则被转移至费格森路的中国市政俱乐部。

同一线人叙述称，据称当地军政官员已收到南京方面的命令，若中日谈判陷入僵局且日本海军陆战队在中国领土上开启战端，则进行抵抗，并在等待沿京沪铁路和沪杭铁路最近地点的增援部队到达期间，坚守该地区数小时。

据报，手榴弹已发放给公安局后备部队和保安总队（Peace Preservation Corps）的成员，并雇用工人在不被外人察觉的情况下悄悄制作铁丝网路障和沙袋。

谭绍良
警司。

S.1, Special Branch Station.

Date October 5, 1936.

Subject: - New Victor Trust Co., "Lungtao Arsenal" sent to Nanking.

Reference is made to my report of the 2nd instant, D/7492, regarding the above.

2. I have now to report that on the 3rd instant, at about 10 a.m., one Hsu Chi-chang (许济昌), who is said to be the Manager of the New Victor Trust Co., accompanied by one Chang Fu-lin (张福林), called at this Office and stated that they had received instructions from Nanking to send the "Lungtao Arsenal" to Nanking. They further stated that they had already packed up the Arsenal and were ready to send it off. They requested me to issue a pass for the same.

3. I thereupon issued a pass for the "Lungtao Arsenal" to be sent to Nanking, and warned them that they must not send any arms or ammunition without the permission of the Commissioner of Police.

4. I have to add that the "Lungtao Arsenal" consists of the following: -

   (a) 100 rifles.
   (b) 50,000 rounds of ammunition.
   (c) 10 machine guns.
   (d) 20,000 rounds of machine gun ammunition.

5. The above was sent off by train at 11.30 a.m. on the 3rd instant, in charge of one Wang Te-sheng (王德胜), who is said to be an employee of the New Victor Trust Co.

6. Submitted for information.

(Sgd.) J. H. M. MacNabb,
     Inspector of Police,
     Special Branch.

To: The Commissioner of Police.

事由：- 新维克信托公司，“龙涛兵工厂”运往南京。

兹提及我于本月2日关于上述事项的报告，编号 D/7492。

2. 现报告称，本月3日上午10时许，据称为新维克信托公司经理的许济昌，在张福林陪同下，来到本办事处，声称接到南京指令，将“龙涛兵工厂”运往南京。他们进一步表示，已将兵工厂物资打包完毕，准备发运。他们请求我签发通行证。

3. 我随即签发了将“龙涛兵工厂”运往南京的通行证，并警告他们，未经警务处处长许可，不得运送任何武器或弹药。

4. 需补充说明，“龙涛兵工厂”物资包括以下内容：-

   (a) 步枪100支。
   (b) 子弹50,000发。
   (c) 机枪10挺。
   (d) 机枪子弹20,000发。

5. 上述物资由据称为新维克信托公司职员的王德胜负责，于本月3日上午11时30分乘火车发运。

6. 呈报供阅知。

（签名）J. H. M. MacNabb，
     警司，
     特别处。

SECRET
SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
File No. D. 7552
S.1, Special Branch 36/10/87
REPORT
Date October 5, 1936.
Subject Persecution of Christians by local Chinese
Reference Nil.
Enclosures Nil.

1. The following information has been received from a source which has proved reliable in the past:-

"During the last few months there has been a marked increase in the persecution of Christians by the local Chinese. This is particularly noticeable in the Yangtszepoo and Nanshih districts where many small chapels have been closed down and their congregations dispersed. In some cases the buildings have been taken over by local organisations for other purposes.

2. The reason for this movement is not entirely clear but it is believed to be due partly to anti-foreign feeling and partly to the influence of certain secret societies who regard Christianity as a threat to their own power and influence.

3. It is reported that in several instances members of the congregations have been threatened with violence if they continue to attend services. In one case a chapel was set on fire and completely destroyed. The police have so far been unable to trace the perpetrators of these outrages.

4. The situation is causing considerable anxiety among the foreign missionary bodies who fear that unless steps are taken to protect the Christians there may be a general outbreak of violence against them.

5. It is suggested that the matter should be brought to the notice of the Chinese authorities with a view to obtaining their assurance that adequate protection will be afforded to the Christians and their places of worship."

(Sgd.) J.H. MACKENZIE
Superintendent of Police.

档案号 D. 7552

报告
日期 1936年10月5日。
事由 当地华人迫害基督徒
参考 无。
附件 无。

1. 从过去证明可靠的来源收到以下信息：-

“在过去几个月里，当地华人对基督徒的迫害显著增加。这在杨树浦和南市地区尤为明显，许多小教堂被关闭，信徒被驱散。在某些情况下，建筑物被当地组织占用作其他用途。

2. 这一运动的原因尚不完全清楚，但据信部分是由于排外情绪，部分是由于某些秘密会社的影响，这些会社视基督教对其权力和影响力的威胁。

3. 据报道，在多起事件中，信徒受到威胁，如果继续参加礼拜活动将遭受暴力。在其中一起案件中，一座教堂被纵火并完全烧毁。警方迄今未能查明这些暴行的肇事者。

4. 这种情况在外国传教团体中引起了相当大的焦虑，他们担心如果不采取措施保护基督徒，可能会爆发针对他们的普遍暴力事件。

5. 建议将此事项提请中国当局注意，以期获得其保证，将为基督徒及其礼拜场所提供充分保护。”

（签名）J.H. MACKENZIE
警务总监。

Subject Rumours in connection with the local situation.

Made by D.I. Sih Tse-liang Forwarded by [Signature]

The following rumours are current among the
Chinese community in Shanghai to-day, October 1, 1936 :-
1. The killing of a Chinese policeman at Pah Dz Jiao,
Chapei, by Japanese marines.
2. The killing of a Chinese policeman in Kiangwan by Japanese
marines.
3. That the Japanese marines will take definite action in
three days.
4. The management of the Huchow Guild on Wei Wen Road,
Chapei, has been secretly instructed by the Chinese
Authorities to make room on the guild premises for the
accommodation of Chinese troops, who will arrive there
shortly.

Sih Tse liang

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
S.1, Special Branch ......
REPORT
Date September 22, 1936.
Subject Two Chinese arrested by members of Paoantui at
North Station
Made by D.I. Sih Tse-liang Forwarded by J.M. Thomson k.s.

At 3 p.m. September 21, 1936, two Chinese were
arrested by members of Paoantui in the Waiting Room of
the North Station for having loitered at the North Station
during the past week and taken down the numbers and units
of the Paoantui on duty at the North Station. The men
arrested are Li Zoong-kwan (李仲昆), age 18, and
Chow Pah-nien (周伯年), age 26. It is reported that
on being interrogated, they stated that they were hired to
do the spying work at the rate of 20 cents each per day,
and were promised extra money for valuable information.

Sih Tse liang
D. I.
Officer i/c Special Branch.

（批：FILE 382）
（印：13 OCT 1936）

1936年9月21日下午3时，两名中国人因在过去一周内在北站徘徊并记下在北站执勤的保安团成员的番号和单位，而在北站候车室被保安团成员逮捕。被捕者为李仲昆 (Li Zoong-kwan)，18岁，和周伯年 (Chow Pah-nien)，26岁。据报道，他们在受审时声称，他们受雇从事间谍工作，每日报酬为20美分，并承诺如有有价值的情报将给予额外酬金。

施子良 (Sih Tse liang)

During the course of the recent hostilities, the North
China Mixed Brigade (three infantry regiments and one artillery
regiment) and the Mixed Brigade of the 20th. Division (two
infantry and one artillery regiments, operated in the Peiping
district whilst the Mixed Brigades of the 5th. and 14th.
Divisions (each comprising two infantry and one artillery
regiments), operated in the vicinity of Tientsin.
    These troops amount to approximately 35,000 men in
addition to 8,000 men of the Mixed Brigade which is now being
transferred from Shanhaikwan to Peiping.

在最近的敌对行动过程中，华北混成旅（三个步兵团和一个炮兵团）以及第20师团的混成旅（两个步兵团和一个炮兵团）在北平地区作战，而第5和第14师团的混成旅（各由两个步兵团和一个炮兵团组成）则在天津附近作战。
    这些部队总数约为35,000人，此外还有8,000人组成的混成旅正从山海关调往北平。
